ask: Should a person's own recordings leave the phone once the server has confirmed them?
problem: Today a person's own recordings stay on their phone for good. Phones fill up, as they did in the old app. The issue asks us to clear them after upload.
found: Other people's audio is cleared when space runs low, after the server confirms it. But passages a person recorded in stay kept for good, so their own audio is never cleared. Nothing clears right after upload.
changed: Nothing yet. This is a decision card only. No code is built until you answer.
why: B matches the issue: own audio is cleared like other cached audio, and still plays offline while there is room. C frees space sooner but hurts low-signal work. A fills phones. A file is never cleared before the server confirms it.
touches: B or C changes decision 166, which keeps every passage a person worked on. The download button would stop saying it is kept for that reason.
